text:
maria: dropping the latest mock for the compact error card + trace actions. main asks: should export sit before the permalink in the kebab menu? also running into truncation for long correlation ids. cc @alex for product tradeoffs

alex: thanks — nice comp. my instinct: put actions in order of primary user intent. most folks want a permalink to share, but export is used in debugging flows. maybe primary action = permalink, secondary = export? curious about metrics. :thinking_face:

maria: we have quick telemetry from the pilot: 60% of clicks on that menu were "download JSON" in the first 2 minutes of a session, permalink ~25%. but permalinks lead to more downstream shares. so tradeoff depending on persona.

jules: from research sessions, when users are in incident mode they want the raw payload quickly. permalinks are used later when they escalate. recommendation: surface "Download" first in the compact mode, but surface permalink as a keyboard-focusable action exposed immediately (no nested submenu).

sam: technically we can reorder easily. caveat: our current kebab menu component is used across many pages and has a default priority order derived from source config. we'll need a prop to flip primary on this card only. small engineering work but fine.

linda: a few microcopy suggestions: instead of "Export" use "Download trace (JSON)" — more explicit, reduces cognitive load. For permalink, copy should be "Copy trace link" (so action is verb-first). Example: `Download trace (JSON)`, `Copy trace link`

maria: love verb-first. also correlation id display: right now we truncate with ellipsis in the middle: `abcd...wxyz`. accessibility issue when users paste and it's truncated. propose full id in a hover tooltip and a visible "Copy ID" button next to it.

a11y-bot: checklist: ensure the copy button has `aria-label="Copy correlation id"`, tooltip accessible via keyboard (focusable), and that truncated text still exposes full string to screen readers (use `aria-hidden="true"` on the visible truncated span and `sr-only` full string). recommend `role="group"` for the id + copy control.

sam: we can implement full id in a visually-hidden element for SRs. two implementation notes: 1) copying long ids to clipboard can fail in some older browsers — we'll add a small snackbar on success/failure. 2) permalinks need to be shortened server-side if we want them to be tiny; otherwise copying the full signed URL is fine but ugly.

alex: on keyboard order: top-level menu button should be first tabbable item, then menu items. but with our inline copy button we must ensure `tabindex=0` ordering: correlation id -> copy button -> kebab. otherwise keyboard users will miss quick copy.

linda: visual suggestion: show small copy icon with label hidden until hover/focus: `[id] [📋]` — icon has `aria-label`. This keeps compactness. Also consider 2-line behaviour on narrow viewports instead of truncating too aggressively.

jules: small user test idea: A/B menu order in compact card for 2 days and measure downstream shares vs downloads. get quantitative before shipping.

maria: next steps I hear: 1) update mock with `Download trace (JSON)` first, `Copy trace link` second in this card 2) add inline copy control for correlation id with SR-friendly markup 3) eng to add prop for menu ordering and snackbar feedback 4) run quick A/B test and 48-hour telemetry. I'll post updated frames by EOD. :thumbsup:

sam: noted. will make a tiny PR to kebab component and add clipboard fallback. ETA 2 days.

a11y-bot: also flag: color contrast for the copy icon at 12px is 3.8:1 currently. needs to be >= 4.5:1 for small text. recommend darker icon or 14px touch target.

maria: good catch — I'll push a token update. thanks everyone!
